description: Which values do Min, Max, First and Last pick over TB.t (b, B, Null, a, empty, a-umlaut, space, A) and which representative does GROUP BY t return for case variants; what changes with a WHERE excluding the empty string, UCase, a concatenation, an all-Null selection, and GROUP BY / ORDER BY on the Yes/No column? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
